title: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Elasticsearch query parsing can lead to denial of service. (CVE-2026-133925)
description: CVE-2026-133925 is a vulnerability in Elasticsearch where an authenticated user with search permissions can cause a denial of service by submitting a query with an excessive number of clauses. The query parser expands these clauses in memory before enforcing complexity limits, which can exhaust heap memory and crash the node.
